info.about: Kirby's Star Stacker is a 1997 puzzle video game developed by HAL Laboratory and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. It is a spin-off of the Kirby series with tile-matching gameplay.
info.trivia: Its Japan-only 1998 Super Famicom remake, Kirby no Kirakira Kids, first reached the West in September 2023 on Nintendo Switch Online under the Star Stacker name.
info.why: The 2023 Switch Online release put Star Stacker back in front of players, and the 1997 Game Boy cartridge is still its only physical release in North America.
